note: Rio Grande NF (Saguache Ranger District) campground on a spruce-and-aspen hillside above the South Fork of Carnero Creek, ~9,100 ft. From US 285 take County Road 41G west 6 miles (paved), then gravel Carnero Creek Road (FR 690) 10 miles and FR 675 west 1.5 miles; the road becomes dirt and single-lane with turnouts inside the forest. No horses or pack animals in the campground. Group picnic area and the rentable Carnero Guard Station cabin nearby. --Claude
summary: FS campground page: confirmed 8 sites, max trailer 25 ft, two vault toilets, no drinking water, $10, first-come only, phone 719-655-2547. flags: Road wording (no RV, 4WD or high-clearance statement): 'County Road 41G becomes a dirt, single-lane road with turnouts after entering the National Forest.' The FS gives a 25-ft maximum trailer length, which a 23-ft rig fits. The page's 'OHV and four-wheel opportunities' is about recreation nearby, not access.

Waterfront riverview confirmed (no change), with a small-creek caveat: the FS describes the campground as on 'a hillside above the South Fork of Carnero Creek' with 'creekside views'. On NAIP imagery the campground clearing sits ~35-60 m south of the creek, which meanders through an open willow meadow with no tree screen between the two; the stream is only a few metres wide, so the view is of a small creek and its meadow. Not creekside: the pads are up the slope, not on the bank.
Phone 719-655-2547 confirmed: Saguache Ranger District, 46525 State Highway 114, Saguache (FS page).
Pin 37.90792,-106.42738 matches the FS lat/long (37.90800,-106.42737), in the campground clearing. OK.
